admin.title: Tier-2 rule admin
admin.forbidden: You do not have access to this page.
admin.notConfigured: Supabase is not configured, so rules cannot be loaded.

cards.title: Cards
cards.lead: Pick a deck, then edit each card's name, meanings and image. Cards you have not edited use the default content.
cards.addPick: Add a card to this deck (not yet customized)
cards.noneToAdd: Every card is already customized in this deck.
cards.name: Name

cardEdit.imageHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF, up to 2 MB. Without an image the site uses the default artwork.
cardEdit.imageBadType: Only PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF images are accepted.
cardEdit.imageTooBig: The image is larger than 2 MB.
cardEdit.fallbackHint: Untranslated English text shows the Vietnamese content. The English version is stored separately only after you edit it.
cardEdit.name: Card name
cardEdit.resetConfirm: Remove all edits to this card in the current deck? It will go back to the default content.

decks.title: Decks
decks.lead: Names and blurbs shown on the home page. A card without its own text in a deck uses the rws deck's text.
decks.name: Name
decks.deleteConfirm: Delete the "{id}" deck with its images and per-card text? This cannot be undone.

spreads.title: Spreads
spreads.lead: Edit names and prompts for each position. Card counts and position ids are tied to the rules, so they are not editable here.
spreads.label: Spread name

content.title: Site content
content.lead: Home page text, sample questions and the legal pages. Anything you have not edited uses the built-in content.
content.defaults: Showing the default content; save to create your own version.
content.resetConfirm: Discard your edits and use the default content again?

analysis.title: In-depth analysis
analysis.lead: Edit each part of the in-depth analysis data. The whole data set is validated before saving.
analysis.fallbackHint: Parts without an English version use the Vietnamese one. Save to create an English version of that part.

hints.safety: Message shown when a question signals distress; no reading is given.
hints.intents: Each intent has an id, a keywords list and lead sentences (use {question}).
hints.lead: Opening sentences with or without a question ({question}, {topic}).
hints.overview: Overview sentences by the lean of the whole spread ({topic}).
hints.positions: Sentences per position and tone (positive, neutral, caution).
hints.cards: Per-card sentences keyed by card id (for example fool). Use {} if none.
hints.transitions: Bridging sentences between two tones, e.g. positive>caution ({from}, {to}).
hints.pairs: Sentences for card pairs, keyed "idA+idB" in alphabetical order. Use {} if none.
hints.single_flow: Sentences when only one card is drawn.
hints.closing: Reflection questions: common, by topic, and the closing note.
hints.card_tone: [upright, reversed] tone of each card: positive, neutral or caution. Vietnamese only.

analysis.resetConfirm: Discard your edits to this section and use the default data again?

users.title: Accounts
users.lead: Registered users, their reading history and admin roles. Locking, deleting and role changes are handled by the api server and logged.
users.selfRole: You cannot remove your own admin role
users.noSession: No active session. Please sign in again.
users.deleteBody: Permanently delete {email} and all of their reading history. This cannot be undone.
users.adminsLead: You cannot remove your own admin role. To lock or delete an admin, remove their role first.

errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have admin access.
errors.cannot_demote_self: You cannot remove your own admin role.
errors.cannot_target_self: You cannot do this to your own account.
errors.target_is_admin: Remove this account's admin role first.
errors.confirmation_required: The confirmation email does not match.
errors.admin_disabled: Admin features are not enabled on the server (missing SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY).
errors.upstream_error: That did not work. Please try again later.
errors.network: Could not reach the api server.

login.title: Admin sign-in
login.lead: Use an account that has been granted admin access. No access yet? Sign up on the website and ask an admin to grant it.

problems.empty: Enter your username and password (at least 8 characters).
problems.rate: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
problems.providerOff: Email/password sign-in is turned off on the server (Supabase → Authentication → Providers → Email).
problems.generic: That did not work. Please try again.
